evidence.note: Opens with environment reconnaissance: checks python3 version, pip list, curl version, sqlite3 version, and confirms /app is empty — probing the runtime (Python 3.12, offline deps, curl access) before building.

Downloads the three pinned vendored libs via curl and immediately runs sha256sum to verify against the exact pinned digests before proceeding — treats the hash pins as a hard constraint to confirm, not assume.
Re-verifies SHA256 of all three libs and explicitly references the '// harbor-canary' single-line strip detail from the spec, confirming the pristine-download-passes semantics rather than guessing.

Extracts and checks explicit realism/hard constraints: Post button label, CSP script-src 'self', seed minimums (8+ accounts, 20+ statuses, 3+ hashtags, 2 CW, 2 media), sign-up CTA — enumerating the verifier's stated requirements.

Enumerates likely gate categories (test_auth, test_durability, test_scopes, test_lists, test_admin, test_polls, test_pagination, test_idempotency, test_cache, test_visibility) and checks anti-cheat surfaces (no node configs, no >1M/exec files) — mapping gate and anti-cheat shapes.

Returns to spec details as they surface — recognizes cache validators (ETag/Last-Modified) were not implemented and adds them, and revisits visibility/scope rules — showing recurring reconciliation against requirements.

reasoning: The agent clearly clears level 5 (extracts all explicit hard constraints — hashes/paths/versions, CSP, seed minimums, endpoint list) and reaches several level-8 markers: it probes the environment (Python version, curl, sqlite, offline deps), confirms the hash-strip/canary detail rather than assuming, and enumerates both the gate categories and anti-cheat surfaces. It falls short of a full 8-10 because the Mastodon wire-contract model was built from internal recall rather than actively consulting docs.joinmastodon.org, the 5 anti-cheat rules were only partially enumerated, and ambiguities like compressed-time env vars were not resolved with evidence. This places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, closest to 7.
